abilities.name: Card Force Translocation
_curatorNotes: No plunge.go in gcsim character dir — plungeFrames not available.

Prop Arrow CA (chargeHits[2]) spawns a Grin-Malkin Hat at ~frame 113 from CA cast (aimedPropRelease=103 + default travel=10): duration 238 frames (~4.0s), stationary, terminates on recast (len(hats)==maxHatCount kills oldest). Schema does not support summons[] on chargeHits; reviewer to decide representation.
Spiritbreath Thorn (Arkhe: Pneuma) fires on Prop Arrow hit with 6s ICD (skillAlignedICD=6*60). Separate Pyro DMG instance. Not in effects skeleton; reviewer to author.

chargeHits RE-SLOTTED (2026-09-17, T1.5): the three rows were each one step off gcsim's aimed ladder — "Aimed Shot" held the fully-charged slice (80/72), "Fully-Charged Aimed Shot" held the Prop Arrow's (111/103). Now aimedFrames[0] InitAbilSlice(23) D/J 15, aimedFrames[1] InitAbilSlice(80) D/J 72, aimedPropFrames InitAbilSlice(111) D/J 103 (aimedPropRelease). `C` still resolves to the last entry, the Prop Arrow, so the rotation shot is unchanged; the frames report did not flag it because it pairs hA/A by name onto the same shifted values.

noICD (2026-09-17, T1.5): both the fully-charged shot and the Prop Arrow are ICDTagNone in gcsim aimed.go, so every aimed shot applies. Safe on the whole normal ability because N1–N4 are Physical and reach no clock. ⚠️ Per character, not a bow rule — Amber and Venti use ICDTagExtraAttack.

sections.title: Normal Attack
sections.description: Performs up to 4 consecutive shots with a bow.

sections.title: Plunging Attack
sections.description: Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

sections.title: Charged Attack
sections.description:
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, flames will run across the arrowhead before being fired. Different effects will occur based on the time spent charging.
·Charge Level 1: Fires off a Pyro-infused arrow, dealing Pyro DMG.
·Charge Level 2: Fires off a Prop Arrow that deals Pyro DMG, and upon hit, it will summon a Grin-Malkin Hat.
When firing the Prop Arrow, and when Lyney has more than 60% HP, he will consume a portion of his HP to obtain 1 Prop Surplus stack. Max 5 stacks. The effect will be removed after the character spends 30s out of combat.
The lowest Lyney can drop to through this method is 60% of his Max HP.
Grin-Malkin Hat
·Can taunt nearby opponents and attract their attacks. Each opponent can only be taunted by the Hat once every 5s.
·The Hat will inherit a percentage of Lyney's Max HP.
·If destroyed, or if its duration expires, it will fire off a Pyrotechnic Strike at 1 nearby opponent, dealing Pyro DMG.
Only 1 Hat can exist at any given time.
Arkhe: Pneuma
At certain intervals, the Prop Arrow will cause a Spiritbreath Thorn to descend upon its hit location, dealing Pneuma-aligned Pyro DMG.

abilities.name: Bewildering Lights
_curatorNotes: When burstKey is active (Grin-Malkin Cat phase), E dispatches to skillBurst() using skillBurstFrames instead: swap=28, N=14, D=8, J=7. This is the standard QE rotation cancel. Reviewer to decide whether to model as a skill variant with a burst-active condition.

Heal authored (capability sweep 2026-07-28): gcsim skill.go:56-69 — base Skill() heals active for 0.2*MaxHP*propSurplusStacks at hitmark, then zeroes the stacks; no ascension gate, so base kit (the sweep's A1 guess was wrong). Fixed 20% per stack (not talent-scaled); per-stack value scaling on heals is not expressible (perStack is buff-only), so authored at one stack + caveat, per the Lyney C2 curator precedent. The stacking-damage bonus on the same cast is still unauthored.
If a Grin-Malkin Hat is on field when E is cast, the Hat explodes (skillExplode) dealing AoE Charged Attack DMG equal to a Pyrotechnic Strike. Not modeled in effects.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — Nothing prints this number. Cast heals draw no timeline bar or marker, and the Team Builder's capability record for a heal is bare `{kind: 'heal'}` with no magnitude — so "shown at one stack" describes an authored value with no reader. It is a heal magnitude, which the rubric classes with damage magnitudes as never having had a place on a timeline. (Even if it did surface in the TB, N17: an ability caveat reaches RotationNotes and nothing else.) Category: invisible-omission.
abilities.description:
Lyney does a flourish with his hat, unleashing a firework surprise!
When used, he will clear all current Prop Surplus stacks and deal AoE Pyro DMG to opponents in front of him. DMG will be increased according to the stacks cleared, and this will also regenerate Lyney's HP based on his Max HP.

When a Grin-Malkin Hat created by Lyney is on the field, the fireworks will cause it to explode, dealing AoE Pyro DMG equal to that of a Pyrotechnic Strike.
The DMG dealt through the Grin-Malkin Hat in this way is considered Charged Attack DMG.

abilities.name: Wondrous Trick: Miracle Parade
_curatorNotes: Grin-Malkin Cat is a self-state, not a summon entity: Lyney transforms at burstStart=100 frames and the status lasts burstDuration=182 frames (~3.03s, expires at frame 282 from cast start). Normals/charge are NOT replaced — this is not a stance. Modeled as behavior: 'instant'; the cat phase is flagged here rather than in summons[].

E is available at burst frame 101 (burstFrames[ActionSkill]=101); pressing E during the cat phase calls skillBurst() → explosiveFirework(), ending the cat early and spawning the fireworks + Hat immediately. QE cancel is the standard rotation.

Grin-Malkin Hat (modeled in summons[]): natural spawn at frame 282 (burstStart=100 + burstDuration=182). Duration=245 frames=4.08s (~4.1s). If E-cancel used, Hat spawns earlier (~frame 101+). spawnsAt=282 reflects the natural no-cancel case.
Cat ticks deal Pyro DMG to each enemy at most once per cast (burstMarkKey status). Not modeled in effects skeleton.
abilities.description:
Unleashing his magic, Lyney turns himself into a Grin-Malkin Cat that can move around quickly. (Not to be mistaken for the Grin-Malkin Hat. They're two different props!)
When the Grin-Malkin Cat gets close to opponents, it will send flames falling down on them, dealing at most 1 instance of Pyro DMG to each opponent. When the duration ends, he will dismiss the Grin-Malkin Cat and ignite fireworks that deal AoE Pyro DMG, summon 1 Grin-Malkin Hat, and grant himself 1 Prop Surplus stack.

Grin-Malkin Cat can be actively canceled.

passives.name: Perilous Performance
_curatorNotes: Inherited manual trigger — likely onHit callback on Grin-Malkin Hat's Pyrotechnic Strike when HP was drained during the originating Prop Arrow (makeA1CB fires once on the first enemy hit). The +80% ATK bonus is injected directly into the Hat's attack multiplier (addA1), not a standalone buff. Also grants +3 Energy to Lyney on the same hit (missing from effects skeleton). Reviewer to model energy restore and HP-drain condition.
Condition: Lyney must have been above 60% HP at Prop Arrow cast time (propSurplusHPDrainThreshold=0.6). Fires at most once per Hat lifetime (done=true guard).

↻ EFFECT RETIRED 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). passive: — Perilous Performance — effects[0] (damage 80% atk) carried `trigger: manual` and reached no surface. gcsim: `internal/characters/lyney/asc.go:31-37` (`addA1`) — the bonus is `ai.Mult += 0.8` folded into the Grin-Malkin Hat's own Pyrotechnic Strike (`grinmalkinhat.go:37-47`, `AttackTagExtra`), not a separate instance; `asc.go:14-29` (`makeA1CB`) grants the +3 Energy once per Hat (`done` guard), gated on `hpDrained` and Ascension ≥ 1. Retained: the +80% ATK is a multiplier add-on to the Hat's Pyrotechnic Strike (`addA1`), not a damage instance; the +3 Energy fires once per Hat lifetime on its first enemy hit; the gate is Lyney above 60% HP at the Prop Arrow cast (`propSurplusHPDrainThreshold = 0.6`), and the Prop Arrow's Hat is itself unauthored (the schema has no `summons[]` on `chargeHits`). ⚠️ This looks like a CONVERT (`chargeFlatDmg`, scaling atk ratio 80) and is not one. The Hat's strike is `AttackTagExtra`, the same class as Lyney's aimed shots, his Prop Arrow and the C6 Reprised — so a class-wide stat would print the bonus on every charged attack he makes, when it lands on one hit of one Hat, once, only after an HP-draining Prop Arrow. That is the brief's named over-claim case. The +3 Energy has no trigger either: the Hat is unauthored, so there is no hit stream to hang an `onHit` on, and `energy` self-target reaches no planner surface and no TB chip.
passives.description: If Lyney consumes HP when firing off a Prop Arrow, the Grin-Malkin hat summoned by the arrow will, upon hitting an opponent, restore 3 Energy to Lyney and increase DMG dealt by 80% of his ATK.

notModeled.reason: The Rotation Planner doesn't track energy or draw damage amounts, and this only restores Energy and raises how hard the Grin-Malkin Hat's Pyrotechnic Strike hits.

A4 grants all Lyney attacks a DMG% bonus against Pyro-affected enemies: base 60% + 20% per additional Pyro team member (other than Lyney), capped at 100%. gcsim: a4Dmg = 0.6 + (pyroCount-1)*0.2, capped at 1.0; applied as allDmgBonus conditioned on enemy having Pyro aura. The DMG Lyney deals to opponents affected by Pyro will receive the following buffs:

constellations.name: Loquacious Cajoling
_curatorNotes: Inherited manual trigger — likely periodic onField accumulation. Gains 1 Crisp Focus stack every 2s while on-field (c2Interval=2*60), max 3 stacks; all stacks clear on swap. gcsim tracks c2Stacks (0-3). The effect skeleton models one stack at +20% CRIT DMG; stacks field (maxStacks=3) not authored. Reviewer to add stacks modeling and replace manual trigger with onField/periodic.

↻ EFFECT RETIRED 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C2 — Loquacious Cajoling — effects[0] (buff critDmg 20) carried `trigger: manual` and reached no surface. gcsim: `internal/characters/lyney/cons.go:55-88` (`c2Setup`) — `event.OnCharacterSwap` sets `c2Src` and zeroes `c2Stacks` on swap-out; a `QueueCharTask` re-arms every `c2Interval = 2*60` while he is active; the permanent `StatMod` reads `float64(c.c2Stacks) * 0.2` (max 3). Retained: +20% CRIT DMG per stack, one stack every 2s while on field, max 3 (so +60% after 6s of uptime), every stack cleared on swap-out — and that the shape is a per-on-field-segment ramp with no trigger that reaches it. ⚠️ The value shape IS expressible — `{"type":"ramping","startValue":0,"stepValue":20,"stepInterval":2,"cap":60}` is exactly this ladder — but nothing can anchor it. The only honest anchor is the start of an on-field segment, i.e. `onSwapIn`, and character-hosted `onSwapIn` BUFFS have no reader (weapons only, `buffWindows.ts:1699`; the lone character author, Neuvillette C1, is a `gainStacks` read by `sim/stacks.ts:1280`). `onState: 'onField'` does not work either — `getCharacterEffectsForOnState` matches `kind: 'state'` windows by name and no such window is ever emitted. ⛔ Do not fall back to `passive`: +60% CRIT DMG on the always-on chip is false at swap-in and false off field. Shikanoin Heizou C1 is the same unresolved shape and is the second author if a segment-start buff primitive is ever built.
